Class RectangleFieldObstacle

java.lang.Object
xbot.common.subsystems.pose.RectangleFieldObstacle
All Implemented Interfaces:
IFieldObstacle
Direct Known Subclasses:
SquareFieldObstacle
public class RectangleFieldObstacle extends Object implements IFieldObstacle
Rectangle obstacle defined by center + half extents. Collision is tested as: (segment swept by robotRadius) intersects rectangle invalid input: '<'=> segment intersects the rectangle inflated by robotRadius in X and Y.
